invalidation_rule: Any change to the numerical/GPU code path, dtype, reduction order, preprocessing math, model fitting path, alignment math, or stability computation invalidates all pilot shards; they must be recomputed.
non_numerical_change_rule: Logging/progress/checkpoint-wrapper changes may retain pilot shards only if the numerical implementation hash is unchanged and the shard validation hash passes.
pilot_dataset_selection: Use the first prespecified dataset IDs in frozen final_gate_calibration_replicates.csv order; do not select pilot datasets based on observed scientific results or runtime difficulty.
pilot_scientific_output_visibility: During runtime pilot execution, print timing/VRAM/progress only. Do not print or aggregate TPR, FNR, FDP, familywise false acceptance, or final-gate PASS/FAIL.
purpose: Measure production wall time, VRAM, shard size, and ETA without making scientific decisions.
reuse_rule: Pilot shards may be retained as final shards only when the numerical implementation hash is unchanged.
